[EN] You are about to enter the Play Room.

A piece of advice: Break the orbs he rolls toward you. They're imbued with magical power, and if you smash them, you can take on that power.

Oh, and don't take too long. One-Eyed Jack is not known for patience.
[ES] Estás a punto de entrar a la Play Room.

Un consejo: destruye las orbs que hace rodar hacia ti. Están imuidas de poder mágico, y si las destrozas, puedes absorber ese poder.

Ah, y no tardes demasiado. One-Eyed Jack no se conoce por su paciencia.
